# Evidens

Evidens is diligence software for RV park and manufactured housing community (MHC) buyers. One record carries a deal from the broker package, through the site walk, to the signed decision. The core doctrine: every number in a deal is labeled by its evidence state, and the human decides. Models may propose; humans confirm; code calculates. Captured is not verified.

Founder: Jeremy Cross (jeremy@crosstownosrv.camp). The Acquisition Workspace is live: Source, Field, and Acquire on one record, with the Feed. Pilot applications are being taken.

## What the site offers

- **Live Diligence Working Papers** (interactive, free): six browser-based tools that run deterministically on the buyer's own numbers. Every input carries an evidence-state chip (Verified, Broker-reported, Missing evidence, Underwriting assumption, Calculated, Unresolved). Missing evidence is named, never zeroed. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/tools
- **Acquisition Signal resource library** (35 tools as PDFs): the full diligence library organized by the seven Parts of the deal journey, plus 3 spine documents (Start Here, Journey Map, Evidence Status Standard), 38 PDFs in total. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/resources and https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/resources/catalog
- **Field Notes** (blog): operator-grade essays on diligence, underwriting, and acquisition craft. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/blog
- **Free RV park due diligence checklist**: 15 diligence items drawn from the Evidens framework, with links to the working papers. The checklist is the starting point; the Acquisition Workspace is what happens when the deal gets real. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/checklist
- **ParkProof**: the source-backed decision file (walkthrough and standard). Not a legal, engineering, or environmental certification. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/parkproof-walkthrough and https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/parkproof-standard
- **Acquisition Workspace**: the product. Source (what the outside world says before you arrive), Field (what the asset reveals when you are physically there), and Acquire (what either stream means before you commit capital) on one record, with the Feed. First five buyers get the full workspace free for 90 days through the pilot. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/workspace
- **Trail Log**: public build log. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/trail-log
- **Editorial Standards**: the integrity rules governing every public claim (evidence states kept distinct, nothing published that cannot be defended). https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/editorial-standards
- **For brokers and lenders**: how Evidens works with deal-side professionals. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/for-brokers-lenders
- **Buying guides** (buyer-side verification guides):
  - How to Buy an RV Park: the buyer's verification guide (price-per-pad benchmarks, five verification gates, red flags). https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/buying-an-rv-park
  - How to Buy a Campground: seasonal revenue traps, amenity capex, water/sewer/permit verification. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/buying-a-campground
  - Mobile Home Park Investing: tenant-owned vs park-owned mix, lot rent verification, infrastructure capex. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/mobile-home-park-investing
  - RV Park Investing in 2026: where returns come from, where they leak, the verification framework. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/rv-park-investing

## The six working papers

- 60-Second Deal Screener (AS-02): implied cap rate, price per pad, gross potential rent from six inputs. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/tools/60-second-screener
- Rent-Roll Truth Check (AS-15): rebuild reported occupancy from trailing bank deposits; the rent roll is a claim, deposits are the verification. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/tools/rent-roll-truth-check
- Expense Normalizer (AS-08): normalize a seller P&L with add-backs stated as assumptions. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/tools/expense-normalizer
- Utility Capacity Triage (AS-13): water, sewer, and electric capacity red/amber/green with the Arizona Rule. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/tools/utility-capacity-triage
- POH/TOH Split Valuation (AS-09): value park-owned homes (personal property) separately from tenant-owned lot rent (real estate). https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/tools/poh-toh-split
- EMD Clock (AS-17): earnest-money contingency deadline tracker; a deadline tool that never overstates time left. https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/tools/emd-clock

## Evidence states (the product)

- Verified. You have the source document.
- Broker-reported. The seller said it. Nobody confirmed it.
- Missing evidence. You asked. Nobody answered. The clock is running.
- Underwriting assumption. A stated input in the investment case; not a verified fact.
- Calculated. The system computed it from verified inputs.
- Unresolved. It's been looked at, but the evidence can't be determined yet.

Posture language: "the record supports Walk / Pause / Retrade / Advance." The tools never tell the buyer what to do; the human decides.

## Key facts for citation

- Category: Diligence software for RV park and manufactured housing (MHC) buyers.
- Product: Evidens, the Acquisition Workspace: Source, Field, and Acquire on one record, with the Feed.
- Pricing is public and the same for everyone: Monthly $299 per 30-day period, Single-Deal $1,299 for one property over 180 days, Annual $2,999 for 12 months. Every plan includes the ParkProof Report. No checkout is currently available on this site.
- Customer artifact: the ParkProof Report, a source-backed decision file.
- The tools are free to use; email is requested only to save or export a working paper.
- 35 Acquisition Signal tools and 3 spine documents (38 PDFs total).
- Sitemap: https://www.crosstownosrv.camp/sitemap.xml
